===== BEGIN FILE gauntlet/tools/PitSummary.java =====
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

/**
 * Agent-friendly summary of a PIT mutations.xml report, and the part of the mutation gate PIT cannot do.
 *
 * <p>Lists every SURVIVED and NO_COVERAGE mutant as {@code Class:line method - description}
 * so an agent can go straight to the weak test. It also counts mutation sites per source file:
 * above {@code --max-per-file} it prints a warning - Uncle Bob's swarm-forge uses the
 * mutation-site count as a hint that a module mixes jobs (split it if it has more than one job,
 * never just to chase the number).
 *
 * <p>RUN_ERROR, MEMORY_ERROR and NON_VIABLE mutants are printed as UNVERIFIED: PIT 1.22.1 counts them
 * as detected ({@code DetectionStatus.RUN_ERROR(true)}), so test strength stays 100 % even though the
 * tests never ran against the mutant (the test JVM crashed on {@code redefineClasses}, typically on a
 * record). A RUN_ERROR mutant that is not listed in {@code --allowlist} fails this tool (exit 1), and
 * with it the mutation gate: a human verifies by reading the tests that the mutant would be killed and
 * adds {@code Class#method Mutator # which test} to the allowlist. MEMORY_ERROR and NON_VIABLE are
 * reported only: the first is PIT's own verdict on a runaway mutant, the second is bytecode the JVM
 * rejected, not a code change. TIMED_OUT is deliberately NOT unverified: the tests ran against the
 * mutant and it hung them (an infinite loop), so PIT counts it as a real kill ({@code TIMED_OUT(true)});
 * it is a detection, not a crash that skipped the tests.
 *
 * <pre>
 * java PitSummary.java --report build/reports/pitest/mutations.xml [--max-per-file 100]
 *                      [--allowlist gauntlet/config/pit-runerror-allowlist.txt]
 * </pre>
 * Exit codes: 0 = summary printed (or no report), 1 = unverified RUN_ERROR mutants outside the allowlist,
 * 2 = usage or unreadable report / allowlist.
 */
public class PitSummary {

    static final String RUN_ERROR = "RUN_ERROR";
    static final List<String> UNVERIFIED = List.of(RUN_ERROR, "MEMORY_ERROR", "NON_VIABLE");

    record Mutant(String status, String sourceFile, String mutatedClass, String method,
                  int line, String mutator, String description) {
        String simpleMutator() {
            return mutator.substring(mutator.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
        }

        String display() {
            return mutatedClass + ":" + line + " " + method + "() - " + description + " [" + simpleMutator() + "]";
        }
    }

    /** One allowlist line: exact class, glob method, glob mutator ({@code *} = any). */
    record Allowed(String mutatedClass, Pattern method, Pattern mutator) {
        boolean covers(Mutant m) {
            return mutatedClass.equals(m.mutatedClass()) && method.matcher(m.method()).matches()
                    && mutator.matcher(m.simpleMutator()).matches();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.exit(run(args, utf8(FileDescriptor.out), utf8(FileDescriptor.err)));
    }

    static PrintStream utf8(FileDescriptor fd) {
        return new PrintStream(new FileOutputStream(fd), true, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        String report = null;
        String allowlist = null;
        int maxPerFile = 100;
        try {
            for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i += 2) {
                if (i + 1 >= args.length) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("option " + args[i] + " needs a value");
                }
                switch (args[i]) {
                    case "--report" -> report = args[i + 1];
                    case "--max-per-file" -> maxPerFile = Integer.parseInt(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--allowlist" -> allowlist = args[i + 1];
                    default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown option " + args[i]);
                }
            }
            if (report == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("--report is required");
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            err.println("PitSummary: " + e.getMessage());
            return 2;
        }
        File xml = new File(report);
        if (!xml.isFile()) {
            out.println("PIT summary: no report at " + report + " (PIT did not run or found nothing to mutate).");
            return 0;
        }
        List<Mutant> mutants;
        List<Allowed> allowed;
        try {
            mutants = parse(xml);
            allowed = allowlist == null ? List.of() : readAllowlist(new File(allowlist));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            err.println("PitSummary: cannot read " + report + " or " + allowlist + ": " + e);
            return 2;
        }
        print(mutants, maxPerFile, out);
        return gate(mutants, allowed, allowlist, out) ? 0 : 1;
    }

    /**
     * JDK 24 and newer count every reference to a built-in entity ({@code &lt;}, {@code &quot;}) against
     * jdk.xml.maxGeneralEntitySizeLimit, 100,000 per document: a large report full of escaped names stopped the tool.
     * The report declares no entity of its own (a DOCTYPE is refused), so only the size limits are lifted.
     */
    static void liftSizeLimits(DocumentBuilderFactory f) {
        for (String limit : List.of("maxGeneralEntitySizeLimit", "totalEntitySizeLimit")) {
            try {
                f.setAttribute("http://www.oracle.com/xml/jaxp/properties/" + limit, "0");
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException olderParser) {   // a parser without the limit needs no lifting
            }
        }
    }

    static List<Mutant> parse(File xml) throws Exception {
        DocumentBuilderFactory f = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
        f.setNamespaceAware(false);
        // PIT writes mutations.xml without a DOCTYPE. A DOCTYPE in the report could declare an external entity, and
        // the summary printed the file it named as a mutant's description (XXE): such a report is not read.
        f.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true);
        liftSizeLimits(f);
        Document doc = f.newDocumentBuilder().parse(xml);
        List<Mutant> list = new ArrayList<>();
        NodeList nodes = doc.getElementsByTagName("mutation");
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.getLength(); i++) {
            Element m = (Element) nodes.item(i);
            String line = text(m, "lineNumber");
            list.add(new Mutant(m.getAttribute("status"), text(m, "sourceFile"), text(m, "mutatedClass"),
                    text(m, "mutatedMethod"), line.isEmpty() ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(line),
                    text(m, "mutator"), text(m, "description")));
        }
        return list;
    }

    /** {@code fully.qualified.Class#method  Mutator   # reason}; the mutator may be omitted ({@code *}). */
    static List<Allowed> readAllowlist(File file) throws IOException {
        List<Allowed> list = new ArrayList<>();
        if (!file.isFile()) {
            return list;
        }
        for (String raw : Files.readAllLines(file.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            String line = raw;
            int comment = commentStart(line);
            if (comment >= 0) {
                line = line.substring(0, comment);
            }
            String[] tokens = line.trim().split("\\s+");
            if (tokens.length == 0 || tokens[0].isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            int hash = tokens[0].indexOf('#');
            if (hash <= 0) {
                throw new IOException("allowlist line without Class#method: " + raw);
            }
            String mutator = tokens.length > 1 ? tokens[1] : "*";
            list.add(new Allowed(tokens[0].substring(0, hash), glob(tokens[0].substring(hash + 1)), glob(mutator)));
        }
        return list;
    }

    /** A {@code #} starts a comment only after whitespace or at line start: the one inside {@code Class#method} does not. */
    static int commentStart(String line) {
        for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
            if (line.charAt(i) == '#' && (i == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(line.charAt(i - 1)))) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static Pattern glob(String glob) {
        StringBuilder regex = new StringBuilder();
        for (String part : glob.split("\\*", -1)) {
            if (!regex.isEmpty()) {
                regex.append(".*");
            }
            regex.append(Pattern.quote(part));
        }
        return Pattern.compile(regex.toString());
    }

    static void print(List<Mutant> mutants, int maxPerFile, PrintStream out) {
        Map<String, Integer> byStatus = new TreeMap<>();
        Map<String, Integer> perFile = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Mutant m : mutants) {
            byStatus.merge(m.status(), 1, Integer::sum);
            String pkg = m.mutatedClass().contains(".")
                    ? m.mutatedClass().substring(0, m.mutatedClass().lastIndexOf('.')).replace('.', '/') + "/" : "";
            perFile.merge(pkg + m.sourceFile(), 1, Integer::sum);
        }
        out.println("PIT summary: " + mutants.size() + " mutant(s) " + byStatus);
        for (String status : List.of("SURVIVED", "NO_COVERAGE")) {
            for (Mutant m : mutants) {
                if (m.status().equals(status)) {
                    out.println((status.equals("SURVIVED") ? "SURVIVED    " : "NO_COVERAGE ") + m.display());
                }
            }
        }
        for (String status : UNVERIFIED) {
            for (Mutant m : mutants) {
                if (m.status().equals(status)) {
                    out.println(status + " ".repeat(Math.max(1, 12 - status.length())) + m.display()
                            + " - UNVERIFIED: tests did not run");
                }
            }
        }
        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : perFile.entrySet()) {
            if (e.getValue() > maxPerFile) {
                out.println("WARNING " + e.getKey() + " has " + e.getValue() + " mutation sites (> " + maxPerFile
                        + "). If it has more than one job, split it; do not split a one-job module just to chase the count.");
            }
        }
        if (byStatus.getOrDefault("SURVIVED", 0) > 0) {
            out.println("  A surviving mutant is a code change no test noticed: add or sharpen an assertion that");
            out.println("  fails for it. If you believe it is equivalent (cannot be detected), stop and tell the human.");
        }
        if (byStatus.getOrDefault("NO_COVERAGE", 0) > 0) {
            out.println("  NO_COVERAGE lines are not executed by any unit test - cover them or delete dead code.");
        }
    }

    /** The gate: every RUN_ERROR mutant is either human-verified (allowlist) or a red gate. */
    static boolean gate(List<Mutant> mutants, List<Allowed> allowed, String allowlist, PrintStream out) {
        List<Mutant> unverified = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Mutant m : mutants) {
            if (m.status().equals(RUN_ERROR) && allowed.stream().noneMatch(a -> a.covers(m))) {
                unverified.add(m);
            }
        }
        if (unverified.isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }
        out.println("mutationGate: " + unverified.size() + " RUN_ERROR mutant(s) not verified by any test and not in "
                + (allowlist == null ? "an allowlist" : allowlist) + ":");
        for (Mutant m : unverified) {
            out.println("  " + m.mutatedClass() + "#" + m.method() + " " + m.simpleMutator());
        }
        out.println("  PIT counts RUN_ERROR as detected; this gate does not. The test JVM crashed before the tests ran");
        out.println("  (usually redefineClasses on a record). Read the tests and name the assertion that would fail for");
        out.println("  the mutant, then stop and ask the human to add that line (with the test as the reason) to the");
        out.println("  allowlist - or fix the crash. Agents cannot edit the allowlist.");
        return false;
    }

    static String text(Element parent, String tag) {
        NodeList n = parent.getElementsByTagName(tag);
        return n.getLength() == 0 ? "" : n.item(0).getTextContent().trim();
    }
}

===== END FILE gauntlet/tools/PitSummary.java =====

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.DataInputStream;
import java.io.FileDescriptor;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.FileSystems;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.PathMatcher;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParser;
import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory;
import org.xml.sax.Attributes;
import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler;

/**
 * Test census: every test class a gate's Test task compiled must have run.
 *
 * <p>The integrity check (B2) reads the build script for test filters, and each review round found a form it does
 * not see: a variable, {@code tasks['test']}, {@code matching { }}, a closure parameter, a filter of the JUnit
 * Platform outside the script. The census judges the effect instead. After the task ran, every test class compiled
 * into its test classes directories must appear in its JUnit XML results (a testcase, passed, failed or skipped).
 * A class that never appears is finding T6, accepted only by the human in the integrity allowlist:
 * <pre>
 *   &lt;path glob relative to the project directory&gt;  T6   # reason
 *   src/test/java/**&#47;LegacyReportIT.java          T6   # runs nightly against a real Oracle, not in the gate
 * </pre>
 * The path is the class's source file when the task's source roots hold it, else the class file.
 *
 * <p>What counts as a test class follows the discovery of the test frameworks (checked on Gradle 8.14.3), and
 * errs on the side of counting less: a class counted that the framework never runs would be a red no fix can
 * clear. JUnit Jupiter: a method annotated {@code @Test}, {@code @RepeatedTest}, {@code @TestFactory},
 * {@code @TestTemplate} or {@code @ParameterizedTest}, not static, private or abstract (a factory returns a value,
 * the others void), declared in the class, in a superclass or as a default method of an interface among the
 * scanned classes; the class is top-level or static nested, or an inner class marked {@code @Nested} in such a
 * class, and is not abstract or private. JUnit 4: a public void instance method annotated {@code @org.junit.Test}
 * of the class or of a scanned superclass, in a public class (the vintage engine discovers no other). TestNG: a
 * void instance method of the class itself annotated {@code @org.testng.annotations.Test}, or a public no-argument
 * one when the class carries it (Gradle's TestNG detection passes on no inherited ones), minus what
 * {@code @Ignore} takes out - TestNG reports nothing for it, and the integrity check (T3) judges it.
 * Not recognised, so never a finding: custom meta-annotations, JUnit Platform suites, Spock, JUnit 3.
 *
 * <pre>
 * java TestCensus.java --project-dir . [--allowlist gauntlet/config/integrity-allowlist.txt]
 *     --task test --classes-file &lt;list&gt; [--sources-file &lt;list&gt;] (--results &lt;dir&gt; | --not-run &lt;outcome&gt;)
 *     [--task archTest ...]
 * </pre>
 * The list files hold absolute paths, each ended by a NUL character (gauntlet.gradle writes them): the task's test
 * classes directories and the source roots of the source sets that compile into them. {@code --results} is the
 * task's JUnit XML directory; {@code --not-run} says the task ran no test in this build (SKIPPED), so nothing on
 * disk counts. Exit codes: 0 = every test class ran or is allowlisted, 1 = findings, 2 = usage or input error.
 */
public class TestCensus {

    static final String RULE = "T6";

    // access flags (JVMS 4.1, 4.6, 4.7.6)
    static final int PUBLIC = 0x0001;
    static final int PRIVATE = 0x0002;
    static final int STATIC = 0x0008;
    static final int BRIDGE = 0x0040;
    static final int INTERFACE = 0x0200;
    static final int ABSTRACT = 0x0400;
    static final int SYNTHETIC = 0x1000;
    static final int ANNOTATION = 0x2000;
    static final int ENUM = 0x4000;
    static final int MODULE = 0x8000;

    static final Set<String> JUPITER = Set.of("org/junit/jupiter/api/Test", "org/junit/jupiter/api/RepeatedTest",
            "org/junit/jupiter/api/TestTemplate", "org/junit/jupiter/params/ParameterizedTest");
    static final String JUPITER_FACTORY = "org/junit/jupiter/api/TestFactory";
    static final String NESTED = "org/junit/jupiter/api/Nested";
    static final String JUNIT4 = "org/junit/Test";
    static final String TESTNG = "org/testng/annotations/Test";
    static final String TESTNG_IGNORE = "org/testng/annotations/Ignore";
    static final String TESTNG_ANNOTATIONS = "org/testng/annotations/";

    enum Nesting { TOP, MEMBER, LOCAL, ANONYMOUS }

    record Method(String name, String descriptor, int access, Set<String> annotations) {
        /** Name and parameter types: a method of a subclass with the same ones hides this one. */
        String signature() {
            return name + descriptor.substring(0, descriptor.indexOf(')') + 1);
        }

        boolean returnsVoid() {
            return descriptor.endsWith(")V");
        }

        boolean is(int flag) {
            return (access & flag) != 0;
        }
    }

    /** What the census reads of a class file. For a member class, {@code innerAccess} is its declared access. */
    record ClassFile(String name, String superName, List<String> interfaces, int access, Set<String> annotations,
                     List<Method> methods, String sourceFile, Nesting nesting, String outer, int innerAccess, Path file) {
        boolean is(int flag) {
            return (access & flag) != 0;
        }

        /** Private, static, public as declared: a nested class keeps them in InnerClasses, not in its own flags. */
        boolean declared(int flag) {
            return ((nesting == Nesting.MEMBER ? innerAccess : access) & flag) != 0;
        }

        String packageName() {
            int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
            return slash < 0 ? "" : name.substring(0, slash);
        }

        String binaryName() {
            return name.replace('/', '.');
        }
    }

    record Allow(PathMatcher matcher, String ruleId) {
    }

    /** One Test task: its compiled classes, where their sources live, and its results (null: it ran nothing). */
    record Task(String name, List<Path> classDirs, List<Path> sourceRoots, Path results, String notRun,
                List<Path> notCompiled) {
    }

    /** A test class that did not run, or (className null) a test source the build left out of the compilation. */
    record Finding(String task, String path, String className) {
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.exit(run(args, utf8(FileDescriptor.out), utf8(FileDescriptor.err)));
    }

    static PrintStream utf8(FileDescriptor fd) {
        return new PrintStream(new FileOutputStream(fd), true, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        Path projectDir = Path.of(".");
        Path allowlist = null;
        List<Task> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            String name = null;
            List<Path> classDirs = null;
            List<Path> sourceRoots = List.of();
            Path results = null;
            String notRun = null;
            List<Path> notCompiled = List.of();
            for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i += 2) {
                if (i + 1 >= args.length) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(args[i] + " needs a value");
                }
                String value = args[i + 1];
                switch (args[i]) {
                    case "--project-dir" -> projectDir = Path.of(value);
                    case "--allowlist" -> allowlist = Path.of(value);
                    case "--task" -> {
                        if (name != null) {
                            tasks.add(task(name, classDirs, sourceRoots, results, notRun, notCompiled));
                        }
                        name = value;
                        classDirs = null;
                        sourceRoots = List.of();
                        results = null;
                        notRun = null;
                        notCompiled = List.of();
                    }
                    case "--classes-file" -> classDirs = paths(value);
                    case "--sources-file" -> sourceRoots = paths(value);
                    case "--results" -> results = Path.of(value);
                    case "--not-run" -> notRun = value;
                    case "--not-compiled-file" -> notCompiled = paths(value);
                    default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("unknown option " + args[i]);
                }
                if (name == null && List.of("--classes-file", "--sources-file", "--results", "--not-run",
                        "--not-compiled-file").contains(args[i])) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(args[i] + " before any --task");
                }
            }
            if (name == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("no --task");
            }
            tasks.add(task(name, classDirs, sourceRoots, results, notRun, notCompiled));
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            err.println("TestCensus: " + e.getMessage());
            err.println("usage: java TestCensus.java --project-dir <dir> [--allowlist <file>] --task <name> --classes-file "
                    + "<list> [--sources-file <list>] [--not-compiled-file <list>] (--results <dir> | --not-run <outcome>) "
                    + "[--task ...]");
            return 2;
        }
        projectDir = projectDir.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        try {
            List<Allow> allows = readAllowlist(allowlist);
            List<Finding> findings = new ArrayList<>();
            int allowed = 0;
            List<String> counts = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Task task : tasks) {
                Map<String, ClassFile> classes = readClasses(task.classDirs(), err);
                List<ClassFile> tests = testClasses(classes);
                Set<String> ran = task.results() == null ? Set.of() : ranClasses(task.results());
                if (task.results() == null && !tests.isEmpty()) {
                    out.println("Test census: " + task.name() + " was " + task.notRun() + " in this build, so none of its "
                            + tests.size() + " test class(es) ran");
                }
                Sources sources = new Sources(task.sourceRoots());
                int missing = 0;
                for (ClassFile test : tests) {
                    if (ran.contains(test.binaryName())) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    missing++;
                    Finding finding = new Finding(task.name(), sources.path(test, projectDir), test.binaryName());
                    if (allowed(finding, allows)) {
                        allowed++;
                    } else {
                        findings.add(finding);
                    }
                }
                counts.add(task.name() + " " + (tests.size() - missing) + "/" + tests.size());
                // a test source on disk that the compile task leaves out (a source-set or a compile-task exclude): it
                // has no class, so nothing above can miss it, and nothing at all would run it
                for (Path source : task.notCompiled()) {
                    Finding finding = new Finding(task.name(), relative(projectDir, source.toAbsolutePath().normalize()), null);
                    if (allowed(finding, allows)) {
                        allowed++;
                    } else {
                        findings.add(finding);
                    }
                }
            }
            return print(findings, allowed, counts, out);
        } catch (IOException | UncheckedIOException e) {
            err.println("TestCensus: " + e.getMessage());
            return 2;
        }
    }

    static Task task(String name, List<Path> classDirs, List<Path> sourceRoots, Path results, String notRun,
                     List<Path> notCompiled) {
        if (classDirs == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("--task " + name + " has no --classes-file");
        }
        if ((results == null) == (notRun == null)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("--task " + name + " needs one of --results and --not-run");
        }
        return new Task(name, classDirs, sourceRoots, results, notRun, notCompiled);
    }

    static int print(List<Finding> findings, int allowed, List<String> counts, PrintStream out) {
        findings.sort((a, b) -> (a.task() + '\0' + a.path() + '\0' + a.className())
                .compareTo(b.task() + '\0' + b.path() + '\0' + b.className()));
        long notCompiled = findings.stream().filter(f -> f.className() == null).count();
        for (Finding f : findings) {
            out.println(f.className() == null
                    ? "INTEGRITY " + RULE + " " + f.path() + "  not compiled for " + f.task()
                            + "  |  the build leaves this test source out of the compilation"
                    : "INTEGRITY " + RULE + " " + f.path() + "  compiled but not run by " + f.task() + "  |  " + f.className());
        }
        String ran = "test classes run (ran/compiled): " + String.join(", ", counts)
                + (allowed > 0 ? " (" + allowed + " allowlisted)" : "");
        if (findings.isEmpty()) {
            out.println("Test census: OK - " + ran);
            return 0;
        }
        out.println("Test census: FAILED - " + (findings.size() - notCompiled) + " test class(es) compiled but not run"
                + (notCompiled > 0 ? ", " + notCompiled + " test source(s) not compiled" : "") + "; " + ran + ".");
        out.println("  Something keeps them out of the run: a filter of the Test task (include/exclude, filter, tags,");
        out.println("  engines), a test framework or engine the task does not have, a filter of the test platform, an");
        out.println("  exclude of the test source set or its compile task.");
        out.println("  Fix the cause. Only the human can accept a finding, in gauntlet/config/integrity-allowlist.txt "
                + "(path-glob " + RULE + ").");
        return 1;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ what JUnit and TestNG run

    static List<ClassFile> testClasses(Map<String, ClassFile> classes) {
        Set<String> ignoredPackages = new HashSet<>();
        for (ClassFile c : classes.values()) {
            if (c.name().endsWith("/package-info") && c.annotations().contains(TESTNG_IGNORE)) {
                ignoredPackages.add(c.packageName());
            }
        }
        List<ClassFile> tests = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ClassFile c : classes.values()) {
            if (jupiter(c, classes) || junit4(c, classes) || testng(c, classes, ignoredPackages)) {
                tests.add(c);
            }
        }
        return tests;
    }

    /**
     * A class a framework can instantiate as a test: not an interface, an abstract class, an annotation, an enum, a
     * module descriptor or synthetic, and not private, local or anonymous - none of them runs as a test class.
     */
    static boolean concrete(ClassFile c) {
        return !c.is(INTERFACE | ABSTRACT | ANNOTATION | ENUM | MODULE | SYNTHETIC)
                && (c.nesting() == Nesting.TOP || c.nesting() == Nesting.MEMBER)
                && !c.declared(PRIVATE) && !c.name().endsWith("/package-info") && !c.name().equals("module-info");
    }

    /** Top-level, or static nested: the classes Gradle hands the framework as test classes of their own. */
    static boolean standalone(ClassFile c) {
        return c.nesting() == Nesting.TOP || c.declared(STATIC);
    }

    /**
     * Jupiter runs a top-level or static nested class, and an inner class marked @Nested when the class around it
     * runs (Gradle passes no inner class itself: Jupiter finds it through the outer one).
     */
    static boolean jupiterContainer(ClassFile c, Map<String, ClassFile> classes, int depth) {
        if (!concrete(c) || depth > 64) {
            return false;
        }
        if (standalone(c)) {
            return true;
        }
        ClassFile outer = classes.get(c.outer());
        return c.annotations().contains(NESTED) && outer != null && jupiterContainer(outer, classes, depth + 1);
    }

    static boolean jupiter(ClassFile c, Map<String, ClassFile> classes) {
        if (!jupiterContainer(c, classes, 0)) {
            return false;
        }
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        List<ClassFile> chain = superclasses(c, classes);
        for (ClassFile k : chain) {
            for (Method m : k.methods()) {
                if (seen.add(m.signature()) && jupiterTest(m)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        // default methods of the test interfaces of the class and its superclasses, nearest first
        List<String> queue = new ArrayList<>();
        chain.forEach(k -> queue.addAll(k.interfaces()));
        Set<String> visited = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < queue.size() && i < 1024; i++) {
            ClassFile face = classes.get(queue.get(i));
            if (face == null || !visited.add(face.name())) {
                continue;
            }
            for (Method m : face.methods()) {
                if (seen.add(m.signature()) && jupiterTest(m)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            queue.addAll(face.interfaces());
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** JUnit Jupiter's IsTestMethod, IsTestFactoryMethod and IsTestTemplateMethod, by the annotations themselves. */
    static boolean jupiterTest(Method m) {
        if (m.is(STATIC | PRIVATE | ABSTRACT | SYNTHETIC | BRIDGE)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (m.annotations().contains(JUPITER_FACTORY)) {
            return !m.returnsVoid();
        }
        return m.returnsVoid() && m.annotations().stream().anyMatch(JUPITER::contains);
    }

    /**
     * JUnit 4: the vintage engine discovers a public class only, top-level or static nested; Gradle's own JUnit 4
     * runner fails another one with an initialization error, which is a testcase of its own.
     */
    static boolean junit4(ClassFile c, Map<String, ClassFile> classes) {
        if (!concrete(c) || !standalone(c) || !c.declared(PUBLIC)) {
            return false;
        }
        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
        for (ClassFile k : superclasses(c, classes)) {
            for (Method m : k.methods()) {
                if (seen.add(m.signature()) && m.annotations().contains(JUNIT4) && m.is(PUBLIC) && m.returnsVoid()
                        && !m.is(STATIC | ABSTRACT | SYNTHETIC | BRIDGE)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * TestNG under Gradle: the class's own methods only (Gradle's detection does not take an abstract superclass's
     * tests for the subclass's, checked on 8.14.3), and nothing that @Ignore - on the method, the class or the
     * package - takes out. A class-level @Test makes every public method a test; @Test(enabled = false) counts as a
     * test that did not run: no integrity rule judges it.
     */
    static boolean testng(ClassFile c, Map<String, ClassFile> classes, Set<String> ignoredPackages) {
        if (!concrete(c) || !standalone(c) || ignoredPackages.contains(c.packageName())) {
            return false;
        }
        for (ClassFile k : superclasses(c, classes)) {
            if (k.annotations().contains(TESTNG_IGNORE)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        boolean classLevel = c.annotations().contains(TESTNG);
        for (Method m : c.methods()) {
            if (m.is(STATIC | PRIVATE | ABSTRACT | SYNTHETIC | BRIDGE) || !m.returnsVoid() || m.name().startsWith("<")
                    || m.annotations().contains(TESTNG_IGNORE)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (m.annotations().contains(TESTNG)) {
                return true;
            }
            if (classLevel && m.is(PUBLIC) && m.descriptor().equals("()V")
                    && m.annotations().stream().noneMatch(a -> a.startsWith(TESTNG_ANNOTATIONS))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** The class and its superclasses among the scanned classes, nearest first. */
    static List<ClassFile> superclasses(ClassFile c, Map<String, ClassFile> classes) {
        List<ClassFile> chain = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> visited = new HashSet<>();
        for (ClassFile k = c; k != null && visited.add(k.name()); k = k.superName() == null ? null : classes.get(k.superName())) {
            chain.add(k);
        }
        return chain;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ results

    /**
     * The classes the JUnit XML results name: the classname of every testcase. Only Gradle's own TEST-*.xml: Gradle
     * deletes those when the task runs again, and any other file in the directory would outlive the run it claims.
     */
    static Set<String> ranClasses(Path results) throws IOException {
        Set<String> ran = new HashSet<>();
        if (!Files.isDirectory(results)) {
            return ran;
        }
        List<Path> reports;
        try (Stream<Path> s = Files.list(results)) {
            reports = s.filter(p -> {
                String name = p.getFileName().toString();
                return name.startsWith("TEST-") && name.endsWith(".xml") && Files.isRegularFile(p);
            }).sorted().toList();
        }
        SAXParserFactory factory = SAXParserFactory.newInstance();
        try {
            // a test result names classes; it has no business pulling in a DTD or an entity from elsewhere
            factory.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true);
            factory.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities", false);
            factory.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities", false);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IOException("cannot configure the XML parser: " + e, e);
        }
        DefaultHandler handler = new DefaultHandler() {
            @Override
            public void startElement(String uri, String localName, String qName, Attributes attributes) {
                if (qName.equals("testcase") && attributes.getValue("classname") != null) {
                    ran.add(attributes.getValue("classname"));
                }
            }
        };
        for (Path report : reports) {
            try {
                SAXParser parser = factory.newSAXParser();
                // JDK 24 and newer count every reference to a built-in entity (&quot; in a parameterized test's name)
                // against jdk.xml.maxGeneralEntitySizeLimit, 100,000 per document: a data-driven test class with
                // thousands of cases stopped the census. No entity of the report's own can exist (a DOCTYPE is
                // refused), so the size limits are lifted.
                for (String limit : List.of("maxGeneralEntitySizeLimit", "totalEntitySizeLimit")) {
                    try {
                        parser.setProperty("http://www.oracle.com/xml/jaxp/properties/" + limit, "0");
                    } catch (org.xml.sax.SAXNotRecognizedException | org.xml.sax.SAXNotSupportedException olderParser) {
                    }
                }
                parser.parse(report.toFile(), handler);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new IOException("cannot read the test results " + report + ": " + e, e);
            }
        }
        return ran;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ where a class comes from

    /** Finds the source file of a class in the task's source roots; else the census names the class file. */
    static final class Sources {
        private final List<Path> roots;
        private Map<String, List<Path>> byName;

        Sources(List<Path> roots) {
            this.roots = roots;
        }

        String path(ClassFile c, Path projectDir) throws IOException {
            Path source = c.sourceFile() == null ? null : find(c.packageName(), c.sourceFile());
            return relative(projectDir, source != null ? source : c.file());
        }

        private Path find(String pkg, String fileName) throws IOException {
            if (fileName.contains("/") || fileName.contains("\\")) {
                return null;
            }
            for (Path root : roots) {
                Path candidate = pkg.isEmpty() ? root.resolve(fileName) : root.resolve(pkg).resolve(fileName);
                if (Files.isRegularFile(candidate)) {
                    return candidate;
                }
            }
            // Kotlin does not tie a file to its package directory: a file of that name, when it is the only one
            List<Path> named = index().getOrDefault(fileName, List.of());
            return named.size() == 1 ? named.get(0) : null;
        }

        private Map<String, List<Path>> index() throws IOException {
            if (byName == null) {
                byName = new HashMap<>();
                for (Path root : roots) {
                    if (!Files.isDirectory(root)) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    try (Stream<Path> s = Files.walk(root)) {
                        s.filter(Files::isRegularFile)
                                .forEach(p -> byName.computeIfAbsent(p.getFileName().toString(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(p));
                    }
                }
            }
            return byName;
        }
    }

    static String relative(Path projectDir, Path file) {
        Path absolute = file.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        try {
            return projectDir.relativize(absolute).toString().replace('\\', '/');
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException otherRoot) {      // another drive (Windows): only the absolute path names it
            return absolute.toString().replace('\\', '/');
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ class files

    static Map<String, ClassFile> readClasses(List<Path> dirs, PrintStream err) throws IOException {
        Map<String, ClassFile> classes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        List<Path> unreadable = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Path dir : dirs) {
            if (!Files.isDirectory(dir)) {
                continue;       // a directory not compiled yet; a jar holds no class Gradle scans for tests
            }
            List<Path> files;
            try (Stream<Path> s = Files.walk(dir)) {
                files = s.filter(p -> p.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".class") && Files.isRegularFile(p))
                        .filter(p -> !dir.relativize(p).startsWith("META-INF")).sorted().toList();
            } catch (UncheckedIOException e) {
                throw new IOException("cannot list " + dir + ": " + e.getCause(), e.getCause());
            }
            for (Path file : files) {
                ClassFile c = parse(file);
                if (c == null) {
                    unreadable.add(file);
                } else {
                    classes.putIfAbsent(c.name(), c);       // the first on the classpath is the one that runs
                }
            }
        }
        if (!unreadable.isEmpty()) {
            err.println("TestCensus: not a class file the census can read, not judged: " + unreadable);
        }
        return classes;
    }

    /** The parts of a class file (JVMS 4) the census needs; null when it is not one. */
    static ClassFile parse(Path file) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes;
        try {
            bytes = Files.readAllBytes(file);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IOException("cannot read " + file + ": " + e, e);
        }
        try {
            DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes));
            if (in.readInt() != 0xCAFEBABE) {
                return null;
            }
            in.skipBytes(4);                                                // minor and major version
            int count = in.readUnsignedShort();
            String[] utf8 = new String[count];
            int[] classIndex = new int[count];
            for (int i = 1; i < count; i++) {
                int tag = in.readUnsignedByte();
                switch (tag) {
                    case 1 -> utf8[i] = in.readUTF();
                    case 7 -> classIndex[i] = in.readUnsignedShort();
                    case 8, 16, 19, 20 -> in.skipBytes(2);
                    case 15 -> in.skipBytes(3);
                    case 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 12, 17, 18 -> in.skipBytes(4);
                    case 5, 6 -> {
                        in.skipBytes(8);
                        i++;                                                // a long or a double takes two entries
                    }
                    default -> {
                        return null;
                    }
                }
            }
            int access = in.readUnsignedShort();
            String name = className(utf8, classIndex, in.readUnsignedShort());
            String superName = className(utf8, classIndex, in.readUnsignedShort());
            List<String> interfaces = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int n = in.readUnsignedShort(); n > 0; n--) {
                interfaces.add(className(utf8, classIndex, in.readUnsignedShort()));
            }
            for (int n = in.readUnsignedShort(); n > 0; n--) {          // fields
                in.skipBytes(6);
                skipAttributes(in);
            }
            List<Method> methods = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int n = in.readUnsignedShort(); n > 0; n--) {
                int methodAccess = in.readUnsignedShort();
                String methodName = utf8[in.readUnsignedShort()];
                String descriptor = utf8[in.readUnsignedShort()];
                Set<String> annotations = new HashSet<>();
                for (int a = in.readUnsignedShort(); a > 0; a--) {
                    String attribute = utf8[in.readUnsignedShort()];
                    byte[] body = in.readNBytes(in.readInt());
                    if ("RuntimeVisibleAnnotations".equals(attribute)) {
                        annotations.addAll(annotationTypes(body, utf8));
                    }
                }
                methods.add(new Method(methodName, descriptor, methodAccess, annotations));
            }
            Set<String> annotations = new HashSet<>();
            String sourceFile = null;
            Nesting nesting = Nesting.TOP;
            String outer = null;
            int innerAccess = 0;
            for (int a = in.readUnsignedShort(); a > 0; a--) {
                String attribute = utf8[in.readUnsignedShort()];
                byte[] body = in.readNBytes(in.readInt());
                DataInputStream data = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(body));
                switch (attribute == null ? "" : attribute) {
                    case "RuntimeVisibleAnnotations" -> annotations.addAll(annotationTypes(body, utf8));
                    case "SourceFile" -> sourceFile = utf8[data.readUnsignedShort()];
                    case "EnclosingMethod" -> nesting = nesting == Nesting.ANONYMOUS ? nesting : Nesting.LOCAL;
                    case "InnerClasses" -> {
                        for (int n = data.readUnsignedShort(); n > 0; n--) {
                            String inner = className(utf8, classIndex, data.readUnsignedShort());
                            int outerIndex = data.readUnsignedShort();
                            int innerName = data.readUnsignedShort();
                            int flags = data.readUnsignedShort();
                            if (!name.equals(inner)) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            if (innerName == 0) {
                                nesting = Nesting.ANONYMOUS;
                            } else if (outerIndex == 0) {
                                nesting = nesting == Nesting.ANONYMOUS ? nesting : Nesting.LOCAL;
                            } else if (nesting == Nesting.TOP) {
                                nesting = Nesting.MEMBER;
                                outer = className(utf8, classIndex, outerIndex);
                                innerAccess = flags;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    default -> {
                        // not needed
                    }
                }
            }
            if (name == null) {
                return null;
            }
            return new ClassFile(name, superName, interfaces, access, annotations, methods, sourceFile, nesting, outer,
                    innerAccess, file);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException e) {
            return null;                                                    // cut off, or not a class file at all
        }
    }

    static String className(String[] utf8, int[] classIndex, int index) {
        return index == 0 || index >= classIndex.length || classIndex[index] == 0 ? null : utf8[classIndex[index]];
    }

    static void skipAttributes(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {
        for (int n = in.readUnsignedShort(); n > 0; n--) {
            in.skipBytes(2);
            int length = in.readInt();
            if (in.skipBytes(length) != length) {
                throw new IOException("attribute cut off");
            }
        }
    }

    /** The types of the annotations in a RuntimeVisibleAnnotations attribute, as internal names (JVMS 4.7.16). */
    static List<String> annotationTypes(byte[] body, String[] utf8) throws IOException {
        DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(body));
        List<String> types = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int n = in.readUnsignedShort(); n > 0; n--) {
            String descriptor = utf8[in.readUnsignedShort()];
            if (descriptor != null && descriptor.startsWith("L") && descriptor.endsWith(";")) {
                types.add(descriptor.substring(1, descriptor.length() - 1));
            }
            skipPairs(in);
        }
        return types;
    }

    static void skipPairs(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {
        for (int pairs = in.readUnsignedShort(); pairs > 0; pairs--) {
            in.skipBytes(2);
            skipElementValue(in);
        }
    }

    static void skipElementValue(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {
        int tag = in.readUnsignedByte();
        switch (tag) {
            case 'B', 'C', 'D', 'F', 'I', 'J', 'S', 'Z', 's', 'c' -> in.skipBytes(2);
            case 'e' -> in.skipBytes(4);
            case '@' -> {
                in.skipBytes(2);
                skipPairs(in);
            }
            case '[' -> {
                for (int n = in.readUnsignedShort(); n > 0; n--) {
                    skipElementValue(in);
                }
            }
            default -> throw new IOException("unknown element value tag " + tag);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ input lists and the allowlist

    /** The paths of a list file, each ended by a NUL character, exactly as written. */
    static List<Path> paths(String file) {
        List<Path> list = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (String path : Files.readString(Path.of(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).split("\0")) {
                if (!path.isEmpty()) {
                    list.add(Path.of(path));
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new UncheckedIOException("cannot read the list " + file, e);
        }
        return list;
    }

    /** The integrity allowlist, read as IntegrityCheck reads it: a path glob and a rule id; '#' starts a comment. */
    static List<Allow> readAllowlist(Path file) throws IOException {
        List<Allow> list = new ArrayList<>();
        if (file == null || !Files.isRegularFile(file)) {
            return list;
        }
        for (String raw : new String(Files.readAllBytes(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).lines().toList()) {
            String line = raw.replaceAll("#.*$", "").trim();
            if (line.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            String[] parts = line.split("\\s+");
            if (parts.length >= 2) {
                list.add(new Allow(FileSystems.getDefault().getPathMatcher("glob:" + parts[0]), parts[1]));
            }
        }
        return list;
    }

    static boolean allowed(Finding f, List<Allow> allows) {
        for (Allow a : allows) {
            if (a.ruleId().equals(RULE) && a.matcher().matches(Path.of(f.path()))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

===== END FILE gauntlet/tools/TestCensus.java =====

===== BEGIN FILE gauntlet/tools/report_check.py =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mechanical check of a subagent report (gauntlet/subagents.md, items 2.2 and section 3).

  python3 gauntlet/tools/report_check.py [--repo DIR] [--rev REV] [--run] [--json] REPORT
  python3 gauntlet/tools/report_check.py --hook          # Claude Code SubagentStop hook, matcher ^checker$

What it checks:
  1. the shape of section 3: the header "## Карточка …; ревизия …; модель …; лимит среды: …", the five sections in
     order, a class [гарантия | риск] and at least one evidence line under every numbered claim of «Проверено»,
     «опровергло бы:» under every load-bearing («несущее») claim, one of the three allowed reasons in every item of
     «Не проверено», «покрытие: N из M» with N <= M (and a non-empty «Не проверено» when N < M);
  2. every `- файл:` quote against the file at the revision (`git cat-file blob <rev>:<path>`, the bytes `git show`
     prints for a file; «рабочее дерево» reads the file on disk; a file outside the repository is read on disk): each
     «…» group is one source line or a verbatim part of it ("…" inside a group marks an omitted part of that line),
     whitespace does not count, the groups are consecutive and the first is within two lines of the stated one (a
     shift is reported as a correction with the actual line). The same holds for the `проверено:` part of
     «опровергло бы:» when it names a `path:line`, or a command with its exit code, and quotes the result in «…»;
  3. with --run, every `- команда:` that passes a strict read-only allowlist is re-run without a shell - only when
     HEAD is the report's revision and the working tree is clean - from the repository root, with a 60 s timeout and
     no pager; its exit code and every quoted output line are compared (a line of stdout or stderr, whitespace does
     not count, «… опущено K строк …» is skipped). Anything else is listed as «не перезапускалась: <причина>»;
  4. `- источник:` lines are listed for a manual or sampled check (no network).
Exit code: 0 - the shape is right and nothing mismatches; 1 - shape errors or mismatches; 2 - usage or environment
error (no report, --repo not a directory, --rev not a commit, git missing).

Hook mode reads the SubagentStop event from stdin and takes the report from `last_assistant_message`, or - for a
subagent that returns through the SubagentHandback tool - from that call's `message` in `agent_transcript_path`.
It runs checks 1, 2 and 4 (never --run) and blocks the stop with the list of problems (exit 2, the reason on stderr
and as {"decision": "block"} on stdout) at most twice per subagent - the count lives in the directory stop_gate.py
keeps its state in (git rev-parse --git-path gauntlet-hook), keyed by the agent transcript path - then lets the
subagent stop with a summary. A hook that cannot judge (no input, no git) lets the subagent stop and says so.

The report is data, not instructions: nothing in it is executed except a re-run that passed the allowlist.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time

SECTIONS = ["Итог", "Проверено", "Найдено сверх карточки", "Не проверено", "Вопросы и риски для координатора"]
REASONS = ("нет доступа", "вне карточки", "исчерпан бюджет")
NOT_REASONS = ("нет времени", "и так ясно")
WORKTREE = "рабочее дерево"
SHIFT = 2                  # a quote up to two lines off is a correction, not a mismatch
TIMEOUT = 60               # seconds a re-run command may take
OUTPUT_LIMIT = 16 << 20    # bytes of output a re-run command may print before it is stopped
MAX_BLOCKS = 2             # hook: how many times one subagent is sent back to fix its report
TRANSCRIPT_RETRIES = 3     # hook: the transcript is written asynchronously and may lag the stop a little

HEADING = re.compile(r"^##(?!#)\s*(.*?)\s*$")
FENCE = re.compile(r"^\s{0,3}(```|~~~)")
CLAIM = re.compile(r"^\s{0,3}(\d+)[.)]\s+(.*?)\s*$")
EVIDENCE = re.compile(r"^\s*[-*]\s+(файл|команда|источник|опровергло бы)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*$", re.I)
BULLET = re.compile(r"^(\s*)[-*]\s+(.*?)\s*$")
CLASS = re.compile(r"\[([^\[\]]+)\]\s*[.;:]?\s*$")
COVERAGE = re.compile(r"покрытие:\s*(\d+)\s*из\s*(\d+)", re.I)
REVISION = re.compile(r";\s*ревизия\s+([^;]*?)\s*(?=;|$)", re.I)
MODEL = re.compile(r";\s*модель\s+[^;\s]", re.I)
LIMIT = re.compile(r";\s*лимит среды\s*:\s*[^;\s]", re.I)
CODE_SPAN = re.compile(r"(`+)(.+?)(?<!`)\1(?!`)")
LOCATION = re.compile(r"^(.+):(\d+)$")
EXIT = re.compile(r"\s*\(код\s+(-?\d+)\)")
ARROW = re.compile(r"\s*(?:→|->)\s*")
OMITTED = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:…|\.\.\.)\s*опущено\s+\d+\s+строк\w*\s*(?:…|\.\.\.)\s*$", re.I)
GROUP_SEP = re.compile(r"»\s*«")
GROUP_PREFIX = re.compile(r"«[^»]*»(?:\s*«[^»]*»)*")
REPORT_START = re.compile(r"^##\s*(Карточка|Итог)\b", re.M)
ANSI = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[ -/]*[@-~]")
SHA = re.compile(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{7,64}")


def squeeze(text):
    """Whitespace does not count (section 3): compare texts with every whitespace character removed."""
    return "".join(text.split())


def short(text, limit=120):
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text if len(text) <= limit else text[:limit - 1] + "…"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- parsing the report

class Quote:
    """A `path:line` with «…» groups: a `- файл:` line, or the `проверено:` part of «опровергло бы:»."""

    def __init__(self, line, path, stated, pieces, seps, origin):
        self.line, self.path, self.stated, self.pieces, self.seps, self.origin = line, path, stated, pieces, seps, origin
        self.status, self.detail, self.actual, self.found = "", "", None, []


class Command:
    """A command with its exit code and quoted output lines: a `- команда:` line or the `проверено:` part."""

    def __init__(self, line, command, code, pieces, seps, origin):
        self.line, self.command, self.code, self.pieces, self.seps, self.origin = line, command, code, pieces, seps, origin
        self.status, self.detail, self.actual_code, self.missing, self.output = "", "", None, [], []


class Claim:
    def __init__(self, number, line, text):
        self.number, self.line, self.text = number, line, text
        self.cls, self.load_bearing, self.kinds, self.evidence_lines = None, False, [], []


class Report:
    def __init__(self, text):
        self.lines = [l[:-1] if l.endswith("\r") else l for l in text.split("\n")]
        self.errors = []          # (report line, message)
        self.revision = None      # the header's value: a hex commit name or WORKTREE
        self.claims, self.quotes, self.commands, self.sources, self.free_refutations = [], [], [], [], []
        self.unchecked_items, self.coverage = [], None
        self.counts = {"файл": 0, "команда": 0, "источник": 0, "опровергло бы": 0}

    def error(self, line, message):
        self.errors.append((line, message))


def split_groups(region):
    """«a» «b» → (pieces, separators); None when the region is not a sequence of «…» groups. A quote may contain
    guillemets itself: only "»" followed by "«" separates groups, and matching may merge pieces back (Groups)."""
    region = region.strip()
    if len(region) < 2 or not region.startswith("«") or not region.endswith("»"):
        return None
    inner = region[1:-1]
    pieces, seps, pos = [], [], 0
    for m in GROUP_SEP.finditer(inner):
        pieces.append(inner[pos:m.start()])
        seps.append(m.group(0))
        pos = m.end()
    pieces.append(inner[pos:])
    return pieces, seps


def code_span(text):
    """(content, rest) of the inline code the text starts with, or None."""
    m = CODE_SPAN.match(text)
    if not m:
        return None
    content = m.group(2)
    if len(m.group(1)) > 1 and content.startswith(" ") and content.endswith(" ") and content.strip():
        content = content[1:-1]       # ``  cmd with ` inside  `` - markdown strips one padding space
    return content, text[m.end():]


def parse_location(content):
    m = LOCATION.match(content.strip())
    if not m:
        return None
    return m.group(1), int(m.group(2))


def parse_report(text):
    report = Report(text)
    lines = report.lines
    headings, fenced, in_fence = [], set(), False
    for n, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if FENCE.match(line):
            in_fence = not in_fence
            fenced.add(n)
            continue
        if in_fence:
            fenced.add(n)
            continue
        m = HEADING.match(line)
        if m:
            headings.append((n, m.group(1)))
    first_text = next((n for n, l in enumerate(lines, 1) if l.strip()), None)
    if first_text is None:
        report.error(1, "отчёт пуст")
        return report
    # the header
    if not headings or not headings[0][1].lower().startswith("карточка"):
        report.error(first_text, "нет шапки «## Карточка <номер, название>; ревизия <…>; модель <…>; лимит среды: <…>»"
                                 " первой строкой отчёта")
        body = headings
    else:
        header_line, header = headings[0]
        if first_text < header_line:
            report.error(first_text, "текст до шапки «## Карточка …»: отчёт начинается с шапки")
        m = REVISION.search(header)
        if not m or not m.group(1).strip():
            report.error(header_line, "в шапке нет ревизии («ревизия <git rev-parse HEAD | «рабочее дерево»>»)")
        else:
            value = m.group(1).strip().strip("`").strip()
            if value.strip("«»\"' ") == WORKTREE:
                report.revision = WORKTREE
            elif SHA.fullmatch(value):
                report.revision = value.lower()
            else:
                report.error(header_line, f"ревизия «{value}» - не коммит (git rev-parse HEAD) и не «рабочее дерево»")
        if not MODEL.search(header):
            report.error(header_line, "в шапке нет модели («модель <имя, уровень>»)")
        if not LIMIT.search(header):
            report.error(header_line, "в шапке нет лимита среды («лимит среды: <не достигнут | ходы/время>»)")
        body = headings[1:]
    # the sections: exactly the five, once each, in order
    found = {}
    expected = 0
    for n, title in body:
        plain = " ".join(title.split()).rstrip(":").strip().lower()
        name = next((s for s in SECTIONS if plain == s.lower()
                     or (s == "Проверено" and re.match(r"проверено\b", plain))), None)
        if name is None:
            report.error(n, f"лишний раздел «## {short(title, 60)}»: в отчёте только разделы формата "
                            f"(подзаголовки - «###»)")
            continue
        if name in found:
            report.error(n, f"раздел «{name}» второй раз")
            continue
        index = SECTIONS.index(name)
        if index < expected:
            report.error(n, f"раздел «{name}» не на своём месте: порядок - {', '.join(SECTIONS)}")
        expected = max(expected, index + 1)
        found[name] = n
    for name in SECTIONS:
        if name not in found:
            report.error(len(lines), f"нет раздела «## {name}»")
    bounds = sorted(n for n, _ in headings)

    def section(name):
        if name not in found:
            return []
        start = found[name]
        end = next((b for b in bounds if b > start), len(lines) + 1)
        return [(n, lines[n - 1]) for n in range(start + 1, end) if n not in fenced]

    if "Итог" in found and not any(l.strip() for _, l in section("Итог")):
        report.error(found["Итог"], "раздел «Итог» пуст")
    if "Проверено" in found:
        parse_checked(report, found["Проверено"], lines[found["Проверено"] - 1], section("Проверено"))
    if "Не проверено" in found:
        parse_unchecked(report, section("Не проверено"))
    if report.coverage:
        done, total = report.coverage
        if done < total and not report.unchecked_items:
            report.error(found["Проверено"], f"покрытие {done} из {total} неполное, а «Не проверено» пусто: каждый "
                                             f"не покрытый пункт - туда, с причиной")
    # evidence lines anywhere outside fences are checked, not only under claims
    claimed = {e for c in report.claims for e in c.evidence_lines}
    for n, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if n in fenced or n in claimed:
            continue
        m = EVIDENCE.match(line)
        if m:
            parse_evidence(report, n, m.group(1).lower(), m.group(2))
    report.quotes.sort(key=lambda q: q.line)
    report.commands.sort(key=lambda c: c.line)
    report.sources.sort()
    return report


def parse_checked(report, heading_line, heading, rows):
    m = COVERAGE.search(heading)
    if not m:
        report.error(heading_line, "в заголовке «Проверено» нет «покрытие: N из M по чек-листу»")
    else:
        done, total = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        report.coverage = (done, total)
        if done > total:
            report.error(heading_line, f"покрытие {done} из {total}: N больше M")
    claim, after_evidence, stray = None, False, []      # stray: runs of lines that are neither claims nor evidence

    def flush():
        if stray:
            first, last, owner, sample = stray[0][0], stray[-1][0], stray[0][1], stray[0][2]
            where = f"строка {first}" if first == last else f"строки {first}-{last}"
            if owner is None:
                report.error(first, f"{where}: текст в «Проверено» вне утверждений - там только «1. <утверждение> "
                                    f"[гарантия | риск]» и строки доказательств")
            else:
                report.error(first, f"{where} под утверждением {owner} - не доказательство раздела 3 (файл, команда, "
                                    f"источник, опровергло бы): «{short(sample, 70)}»")
            del stray[:]

    for n, line in rows:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cm = CLAIM.match(line)
        if cm:
            flush()
            claim = Claim(int(cm.group(1)), n, cm.group(2))
            report.claims.append(claim)
            after_evidence = False
            continue
        em = EVIDENCE.match(line)
        if em and claim is not None:
            flush()
            kind = em.group(1).lower()
            claim.kinds.append(kind)
            claim.evidence_lines.append(n)
            parse_evidence(report, n, kind, em.group(2))
            after_evidence = True
            continue
        if claim is not None and not after_evidence and not stray and line[:1].isspace():
            claim.text += " " + line.strip()          # the claim wrapped onto the next line
            continue
        owner = claim.number if claim is not None else None
        if stray and stray[-1][1] != owner:
            flush()
        stray.append((n, owner, line))
    flush()
    for claim in report.claims:
        m = CLASS.search(claim.text)
        parts = [p.strip().lower() for p in m.group(1).split(",")] if m else []
        classes = [p for p in parts if p in ("гарантия", "риск")]
        if not m or len(classes) != 1 or any(p not in ("гарантия", "риск", "несущее") for p in parts):
            report.error(claim.line, f"у утверждения {claim.number} нет класса: в конце - [гарантия] или [риск], "
                                     f"у несущего - [гарантия, несущее] или [риск, несущее]")
        else:
            claim.cls = classes[0]
            claim.load_bearing = "несущее" in parts
        if not any(k in ("файл", "команда", "источник") for k in claim.kinds):
            report.error(claim.line, f"у утверждения {claim.number} нет доказательства: ни строки «- файл:», ни "
                                     f"«- команда:», ни «- источник:» (без доказательства - в «Не проверено»)")
        if claim.load_bearing and "опровергло бы" not in claim.kinds:
            report.error(claim.line, f"утверждение {claim.number} несущее, а строки «- опровергло бы: …; проверено: "
                                     f"… → …» нет")


def parse_unchecked(report, rows):
    items = []
    for n, line in rows:
        m = BULLET.match(line)
        if m and len(m.group(1)) <= 3:
            items.append([n, m.group(2)])
        elif items and line.strip() and line[:1].isspace():
            items[-1][1] += " " + line.strip()
    report.unchecked_items = items
    allowed = re.compile(r"(?:^|\s)[—–-]\s*(?:" + "|".join(REASONS) + r")\b", re.I)
    for n, text in items:
        if allowed.search(text):
            continue
        bad = [r for r in NOT_REASONS if r in text.lower()]
        why = f"«{bad[0]}» - не причина; " if bad else ""
        report.error(n, f"пункт «Не проверено» без допустимой причины: {why}после « — » нужна одна из: "
                        f"{', '.join(REASONS)}")


def parse_evidence(report, n, kind, rest):
    report.counts[kind] += 1
    if kind == "файл":
        span = code_span(rest)
        location = parse_location(span[0]) if span else None
        if location is None:
            report.error(n, "строка «файл:» не в виде `<путь>:<строка>` «<цитата>»")
            return
        if location[1] < 1:
            report.error(n, f"строка «файл:»: номер строки {location[1]} - строки считаются с 1")
            return
        groups = split_groups(span[1])
        if groups is None:
            report.error(n, "строка «файл:»: после `путь:строка` - только группы «…», по одной на строку исходника")
            return
        report.quotes.append(Quote(n, location[0], location[1], groups[0], groups[1], "файл"))
    elif kind == "команда":
        span = code_span(rest)
        if span is None or not span[0].strip():
            report.error(n, "строка «команда:» без команды в `…`")
            return
        m = EXIT.match(span[1])
        if not m:
            report.error(n, "строка «команда:» без кода выхода «(код N)» сразу после команды")
            return
        tail = span[1][m.end():]
        pieces, seps = [], []
        if tail.strip():
            a = ARROW.match(tail)
            groups = split_groups(tail[a.end():]) if a else None
            if groups is None:
                report.error(n, "строка «команда:»: после «(код N)» - «→» и группы «…», по одной на строку вывода")
                return
            pieces, seps = groups
        report.commands.append(Command(n, span[0], int(m.group(1)), pieces, seps, "команда"))
    elif kind == "источник":
        if "«" not in rest or "»" not in rest:
            report.error(n, "строка «источник:» без цитаты «…»")
        report.sources.append((n, rest))
    else:
        parse_refutation(report, n, rest)


def parse_refutation(report, n, rest):
    m = re.search(r"проверено\s*:\s*", rest, re.I)
    if not m or not re.search(r"→|->", rest[m.end():]):
        report.error(n, "строка «опровергло бы:» без «; проверено: <команда | файл:строка> → <результат>»")
        return
    checked = rest[m.end():]
    span = code_span(checked)
    if span:
        location = parse_location(span[0])
        code = EXIT.match(span[1])
        tail = span[1][code.end():] if code else span[1]
        arrow = ARROW.match(tail)
        if arrow:
            prefix = GROUP_PREFIX.match(tail[arrow.end():])
            if prefix:
                pieces, seps = split_groups(prefix.group(0))
                if location and not code and location[1] >= 1:
                    report.quotes.append(Quote(n, location[0], location[1], pieces, seps, "опровергло бы"))
                    return
                if code and not location:
                    report.commands.append(Command(n, span[0], int(code.group(1)), pieces, seps, "опровергло бы"))
                    return
    report.free_refutations.append((n, checked))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- the repository

def run_git(repo, *args, binary=False):
    env = clean_git_env(os.environ)
    try:
        done = subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", *args], cwd=repo, env=env,
                              stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    except OSError as e:
        return 127, b"" if binary else "", str(e)
    out = done.stdout if binary else done.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    return done.returncode, out, done.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()


def clean_git_env(base):
    env = {k: v for k, v in base.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}
    env.update(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0", GIT_PAGER="cat", PAGER="cat", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0", GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH="1")
    return env


class Repo:
    def __init__(self, directory):
        self.dir = os.path.abspath(directory)
        code, top, _ = run_git(self.dir, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
        self.git = code == 0 and bool(top)
        self.root = os.path.abspath(top) if self.git else self.dir

    def commit(self, rev):
        if not self.git:
            return None
        code, sha, _ = run_git(self.root, "rev-parse", "--verify", "--quiet", "--end-of-options", rev + "^{commit}")
        return sha if code == 0 and sha else None

    def head(self):
        return self.commit("HEAD")

    def dirty(self):
        code, out, err = run_git(self.root, "status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=normal")
        return [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip()] if code == 0 else ["git status: " + err]

    def inside(self, path):
        real, root = os.path.realpath(path), os.path.realpath(self.root)
        return real == root or real.startswith(root + os.sep)

    def read(self, rev, path):
        """(lines, note) of the file at the revision (rev None = on disk), or (None, why); read once per report."""
        cache = self.__dict__.setdefault("cache", {})
        if (rev, path) not in cache:
            cache[(rev, path)] = self.load(rev, path)
        return cache[(rev, path)]

    def load(self, rev, path):
        candidate = os.path.expanduser(path)
        on_disk = os.path.join(self.root, candidate) if not os.path.isabs(candidate) else candidate
        if rev is not None and os.path.isabs(candidate):
            if self.inside(candidate):
                candidate = os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(candidate), os.path.realpath(self.root))
            else:
                rev = None              # a file outside the repository has no revision: it is read on disk
        if rev is None:
            try:
                with open(on_disk, "rb") as f:
                    data = f.read()
            except OSError as e:
                return None, f"файла нет или он не читается ({e.strerror or e})"
            note = "" if self.inside(on_disk) else "вне репозитория, прочитан с диска"
        else:
            code, data, err = run_git(self.root, "cat-file", "blob", f"{rev}:{candidate}", binary=True)
            if code != 0:
                return None, f"на ревизии {rev[:12]} нет файла {candidate}"
            note = ""
        text = data.decode("utf-8", "replace")
        return [l[:-1] if l.endswith("\r") else l for l in text.split("\n")], note


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- quote matching

def fragments(text):
    """A «…» group squeezed: "…" inside it marks an omitted part of the line, the rest is verbatim and in order."""
    return tuple(squeeze(part) for part in text.split("…"))


def has(parts, line):
    """One squeezed group against one squeezed line: an empty group quotes an empty line, any other is a part of the
    line (its fragments in order)."""
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return line == "" if parts[0] == "" else parts[0] in line
    pos = 0
    for part in parts:
        if part:
            found = line.find(part, pos)
            if found < 0:
                return False
            pos = found + len(part)
    return True


class Groups:
    """The «…» groups of one evidence line, squeezed once. Pieces split by "» «" that a quoted line contains itself
    are merged back when only the merged text matches."""

    def __init__(self, pieces, seps):
        self.pieces, self.seps, self.cache = pieces, seps, {}

    def text(self, i, j):
        if (i, j) not in self.cache:
            text = self.pieces[i]
            for k in range(i + 1, j):
                text += self.seps[k - 1] + self.pieces[k]
            self.cache[(i, j)] = fragments(text)
        return self.cache[(i, j)]

    def consecutive(self, lines, start):
        """The 1-based lines the groups match when the first is on line `start` (one group, one line), or None."""
        memo, n = {}, len(self.pieces)

        def walk(i, line):
            if i == n:
                return []
            if (i, line) not in memo:
                memo[(i, line)] = None
                if 1 <= line <= len(lines):
                    for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
                        if has(self.text(i, j), lines[line - 1]):
                            rest = walk(j, line + 1)
                            if rest is not None:
                                memo[(i, line)] = [line] + rest
                                break
            return memo[(i, line)]

        return walk(0, start)

    def anywhere(self, lines):
        """The pieces that occur in no line, in any order («… опущено K строк …» is skipped); [] when all do."""
        n, memo = len(self.pieces), {}
        omitted = [bool(OMITTED.match(p)) for p in self.pieces]

        def covered(i):
            if i == n:
                return True
            if i not in memo:
                memo[i] = False
                if omitted[i]:
                    memo[i] = covered(i + 1)
                else:
                    for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
                        if omitted[j - 1]:
                            break
                        if any(has(self.text(i, j), line) for line in lines) and covered(j):
                            memo[i] = True
                            break
            return memo[i]

        if covered(0):
            return []
        # no partition fits, so at least one piece matches no line on its own: name those
        return [self.pieces[i] for i in range(n)
                if not omitted[i] and not any(has(self.text(i, i + 1), line) for line in lines)]


def check_quote(repo, rev, quote):
    lines, note = repo.read(rev, quote.path)
    if lines is None:
        quote.status, quote.detail = "mismatch", note
        return
    squeezed = [squeeze(l) for l in lines]
    groups = Groups(quote.pieces, quote.seps)
    for shift in [0] + [s for d in range(1, SHIFT + 1) for s in (-d, d)]:
        found = groups.consecutive(squeezed, quote.stated + shift)
        if found:
            quote.actual, quote.found = found[0], found
            quote.status = "ok" if shift == 0 else "corrected"
            quote.detail = note if shift == 0 else f"цитата на строке {found[0]}, а не {quote.stated} (поправка)"
            if shift and note:
                quote.detail += "; " + note
            return
    elsewhere = next((s for s in range(1, len(lines) + 1) if groups.consecutive(squeezed, s)), None)
    quote.status = "mismatch"
    if elsewhere:
        quote.actual = elsewhere
        quote.detail = f"цитата есть на строке {elsewhere}, а не {quote.stated}"
    else:
        where = f"на ревизии {rev[:12]}" if rev else "в файле"
        quote.detail = f"цитаты нет {where}"
    if note:
        quote.detail += "; " + note
    first = max(quote.stated, 1)
    quote.context = [(k, lines[k - 1]) for k in range(first, min(first + len(quote.pieces), len(lines) + 1))]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- re-running commands safely

SHELL_OPERATORS = set("|&;<>()")
GLOB = set("*?[")
BRACES = re.compile(r"\{[^{}]*(?:,|\.\.)[^{}]*\}")
DEVICES = ("/dev", "/proc", "/sys")


def split_words(command):
    """The words a POSIX shell makes of a simple command, or (None, reason) when the shell would do more than split
    and remove quotes: an operator or a redirection, a substitution, a glob, brace or ~user expansion, a comment."""
    words, word, mask, in_word, i, n = [], [], [], False, 0, len(command)

    def finish():
        if BRACES.search("".join(mask)):
            return "раскрытие скобок оболочки «{…}»"
        words.append("".join(word))
        return None

    while i < n:
        c = command[i]
        if c in " \t":
            if in_word:
                reason = finish()
                if reason:
                    return None, reason
                word, mask, in_word = [], [], False
            i += 1
            continue
        if c in "\r\n":
            return None, "перевод строки в команде (несколько команд)"
        if ord(c) < 32 or c == "\x7f":
            return None, "управляющий символ в команде"
        if c == "'":
            j = command.find("'", i + 1)
            if j < 0:
                return None, "незакрытая кавычка «'»"
            word.append(command[i + 1:j])
            mask.append("\0" * (j - i - 1))
            in_word, i = True, j + 1
            continue
        if c == '"':
            i += 1
            while True:
                if i >= n:
                    return None, "незакрытая кавычка «\"»"
                d = command[i]
                if d == '"':
                    i += 1
                    break
                if d in "$`":
                    return None, f"подстановка «{d}» в кавычках"
                if d == "\\" and i + 1 < n and command[i + 1] in '"\\':
